name: endnotex9
description: Local-first EndNote X9 assistant: an MCP server that reads, searches, cites and narrowly corrects an .enl library without uploading it, plus skills for cleaning metadata, downloading full text, classifying the library, and close-reading a single paper.

interface.shortDescription: Search, cite, and tidy a local EndNote X9 library
interface.longDescription: Read, search, and cite an EndNote X9 library without uploading it, and drive four skills over it: clean up metadata and duplicates, download and attach full-text PDFs, build a reviewable topic classification, and close-read a single paper. Every write is backed up first, defaults to a dry run, and refuses to run while EndNote holds the library open.
defaultPrompt: Clean up my EndNote library's metadata and duplicates.
Read the paper I have selected in EndNote in depth.
Classify my EndNote library by topic.
